description_en: Queries the details of a specified Anycast EIP instance, including its status, peak bandwidth, and associated cloud resources
description_zh: 查询指定Anycast EIP实例的具体信息，包括实例状态、带宽峰值和已绑定资源的信息等
kebab_example: aliyun eipanycast describe-anycast-eip-address --ip 139.95.XX.XX --anycast-id aeip-bp1ix34fralt4ykf30000 --bind-instance-id lb-2zebb08phyczzawe0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAnycastEipAddress

parameters.help_en:
The IP address of the Anycast EIP instance.

You must specify either Ip or AnycastId
parameters.help_zh:
Anycast EIP实例IP地址。

您必须输入参数Ip和参数AnycastId中的任意一个

parameters.help_zh:

parameters.help_zh: Anycast EIP绑定的云资源实例ID

AliUid.description_en: The ID of the account that owns the Anycast EIP instance

AnycastEipBindInfoList.description_en: The list of cloud resources that are associated with the Anycast EIP instance
AnycastEipBindInfoList.description_zh: Anycast EIP实例绑定云资源信息列表

items.description_en: The list of cloud resources that are associated with the Anycast EIP instance
items.description_zh: Anycast EIP实例绑定云资源信息列表

AssociationMode.description_en:
The association mode. Valid values:

Default: The associated cloud resource instance is the default origin server.

Normal: The associated cloud resource instance is a normal origin server
AssociationMode.description_zh:
绑定模式，取值：

Default：默认模式，绑定的云资源实例为默认源站。

Normal：普通模式，绑定的云资源实例为普通源站

BindInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the associated cloud resource instance

BindInstanceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the associated cloud resource instance
BindInstanceRegionId.description_zh: 绑定的云资源实例的地域ID

BindInstanceType.description_en:
The type of the associated cloud resource instance. Valid values:

SlbInstance: a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance in a virtual private cloud (VPC).

NetworkInterface: an elastic network interface (ENI)
BindInstanceType.description_zh:
绑定的云资源实例类型。取值：

SlbInstance：专有网络类型的CLB实例。
NetworkInterface：弹性网卡

BindTime.description_en:
The time when the cloud resource was associated.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
BindTime.description_zh:
绑定时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

PopLocations.description_en:
The information about the access points in the access areas that are connected to the associated cloud resource instance.

If you associate a cloud resource for the first time, the system returns the access points in all access areas
PopLocations.description_zh:
绑定云资源实例时，关联的接入区域的接入点信息。

如果您是第一次绑定，系统将返回所有接入区域的接入点信息

PrivateIpAddress.description_en:
The secondary private IP address of the associated ENI.

This parameter is returned only when BindInstanceType is set to NetworkInterface
PrivateIpAddress.description_zh:
绑定的弹性网卡的辅助私网IP。

只有当BindInstanceType取值为NetworkInterface时，返回该参数

Status.description_en:
The status of the associated cloud resource instance. Valid values:

BINDING: The cloud resource is being associated.

BINDED: The cloud resource is associated.

UNBINDING: The cloud resource is being disassociated.

DELETED: The cloud resource is deleted.

MODIFYING: The association is being modified
Status.description_zh:
绑定的云资源实例的状态。取值：
BINDING：绑定中。
BINDED：已绑定。
UNBINDING：解绑中。
DELETED：已删除。
MODIFYING：修改中

AnycastId.description_en: The ID of the Anycast EIP instance

Bandwidth.description_en: The peak bandwidth of the Anycast EIP instance. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: Anycast EIP实例的带宽峰值，单位：Mbps

Bid.description_en: The BID of the account that owns the Anycast EIP instance

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The service status of the Anycast EIP instance. Valid values:

Normal: The Anycast EIP is in a normal state.

FinancialLocked: The Anycast EIP is locked due to an overdue payment.

RiskExpired: The Anycast EIP is locked for security reasons
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
Anycast EIP实例的业务状态。取值：

Normal：正常状态。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定状态。
RiskExpired：安全锁定状态

CreateTime.description_en:
The time when the Anycast EIP instance was created.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
Anycast EIP实例创建时间。

时间按照ISO8601标准表示，并使用UTC时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

Description.description_en: The description of the Anycast EIP instance

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the Anycast EIP instance.

The value is PostPaid, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
Anycast EIP实例的付费模式。

取值：PostPaid，表示后付费模式

InternetChargeType.description_en:
The metering method of the Anycast EIP instance.

The value is PayByTraffic, which indicates the pay-by-data-transfer metering method
InternetChargeType.description_zh:
Anycast EIP实例的计费方式。

取值：PayByTraffic，表示按流量计费方式

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the Anycast EIP instance

Name.description_en: The name of the Anycast EIP instance

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs

ServiceLocation.description_en:
The access area of the Anycast EIP instance.

The value is international, which indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland
ServiceLocation.description_zh:
Anycast EIP实例接入区域。

取值：international，表示中国内地以外的区域

ServiceManaged.description_en: Indicates whether the resource is created by a service account. 0: The resource is not created by a service account. 1: The resource is created by a service account
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为服务账号创建的资源。
0：非服务账号创建。
1：服务账号创建

Status.description_en:
The status of the IP address.

Associating: The instance is being associated.

Unassociating: The instance is being disassociated.

Allocated: The instance is allocated.

Associated: The instance is associated.

Modifying: The instance is being modified.

Releasing: The instance is being released.

Released: The instance is released
Status.description_zh:
IP状态。

Associating：绑定中。
Unassociating：解绑中。
Allocated：已分配。
Associated：已绑定。
Modifying：修改中。
Releasing：释放中。
Released：已释放
